brief: McGeoch writes into a tape where copper, aluminium, nickel, zinc, iron ore, coal, gas, oil, gold, silver and platinum are printing all-time, multi-year or seasonal highs. Copper: a Reuters report that the White House has not decided on refined copper tariffs knocked LME $500/mt (3.5%), and a Barron's piece carrying a White House reshoring statement followed. The desk sees no new information in Reuters, blames positioning for the move size (Chinese open interest -42.5k/7%, the largest ever, on almost no price impact), and likes the z6 arb at 1.25%/$181 because tariff risk premium should persist. Cochilco July output fell 23% at Los Pelambres and 22% at Escondida. Gold trades $4350 and GS vol trading adds upside convexity into CPI, selling 1M 1x4 call spreads and buying hedged calls, arguing bad news is priced, 4,330 holds, downside is ~$100/oz on a hike and gold can do $400/oz in two weeks if the Fed does not hike. Brent settled $107.63, +6%, on Trump's post-midterm war comment, Houthi gains near Bab el Mandab and an East-West pipeline attack. Goldman raised 4Q26 TTF to EUR 70/MWh from EUR 53, forwards 79. On RIO, activist chatter is put at under 10%.
